entries.reason: The page answers all four tasks on one class page. Find: a package tree with counts, search, and breadcrumbs. Fields: a five-column table with label, type, required and the list each field draws from. Relations: the badge, the graph and edge table, and the phone relationships list. Trace: a Source line naming module Person (ihris-common) and ihris-suite-4.3.3. The harness visualiser is a tile plus an in-body link. H2 keeps round 2's H design and only adds the eight fixes, as round-3/intent.md asks. All the content is real 4.3.3 data, and nothing is invented (for example, the null label is shown as '(no label)').

At 1280 (h2.web.png) scrollWidth is 1280, so there is no overflow. The field table scans easily, and the graph sits beside an edge table that now names each list's class (country iHRIS_Country) and the field behind each edge. The sidebar excerpt now shows '... 68 above' and '... 21 below · all 93', so it is clear the list is cut. Two small visual issues: the tile's ◯—◯ glyph wraps onto two lines inside the tile, and 'extended by' still wraps in the edge table's first column.

At 390 there is no overflow in either state. The cards label every value, and the disclosures show counts. The opened menu is now drawn (h2-menu.mobile.png): tree, excerpt markers, count note and tile, pushed inline above the page, which keeps it linear. The problem is the touch targets. The menu state sets '.nav a { min-height:32px }' with 3px li padding, so each package and class link is about 38px, not the 44px fix 1 requires. The '... 21 below · all 93' link is 12px text with no minimum height at all. Only the tile (min-height 44px), the Close button, search and the summaries meet 44px.

Fixed: skip link to <main id=main tabindex=-1>, decorative glyphs aria-hidden, explicit table roles on the card table, a <section aria-label> for relationships, and an SVG named by its edges and described by the legend. Still open: (1) the menu button's aria-label 'Open navigation' overrides its visible text 'Menu' in the closed state and 'Close' in the open state. That fails WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name, and in the open state (aria-expanded=true) it still says 'Open'. Drop the aria-label and let the visible text be the name, or use 'Menu' and 'Close menu'. (2) aria-controls='nav' covers only the nav, but the button also reveals the tile, which sits outside #nav. (3) The phone nav targets are below 44px (see mobile usability).

One candidate is justified. This is a scoped refinement round: the owner chose H and asked for its round-2 warnings to be fixed before accepting it (round-3/intent.md). The round-1 A/B alternatives, and C deferred for a stated data reason, are still traceable through the linked intents. The menu-open state is drawn as a second file rather than left assumed.

The opened menu is drawn in h2-menu.html and shows the package tree, the count note and the visualiser tile. The tile has min-height 44px. But the nav links get min-height 32px (about 38px with li padding), and the 'all 93' link has no minimum height, so 'touch targets at least 44px tall' is not met for the tree itself. The button's aria-expanded does flip to true.

The 156 / 153 note (iHRIS_DisciplinaryAction, iHRIS_Registration, iHRIS_SalaryGrade each defined in two packages) is an <li class=note> inside #nav, and it is visible in h2-menu.mobile.png. So a phone user can reach it through the menu.

The first element in is Skip to content. It is off-screen until focused, and it targets
, so focus actually moves past the sidebar.

These glyphs are all wrapped in <span aria-hidden='true'>: ☰ and ✕ in the button, ◯—◯ in the tile and the Neighbourhood h2, ↑ in the extends badge and summary, ↓ in the Extended by summary, and 🔗 in the Lists summary. The SVG arrowheads are inside role=img, so they are not read either. The '…' in '68 above' is meaningful text and is correctly left readable.
The phone relationships list is now <section class='rels' aria-label='Relationships'>, which a named section exposes as a region landmark. It is no longer a div whose label is ignored.

The fields table carries explicit role=table (with aria-label 'Fields of iHRIS_Person'), role=rowgroup, role=row, role=columnheader and role=cell on every element. So display:block in the card layout no longer strips the table semantics. The hidden thead removes the header cells from the accessibility tree on mobile, but each cell's visible ::before label ('Field: ', and so on) covers that.

The SVG has role=img and an aria-label that states the edges: extends the base class I2CE_Form; iHRIS_ManagePerson and iHRIS_QualifyPerson extend it; it draws from country, county, district and region. aria-describedby='hood-cap' points to the legend figcaption. The label does not name the via-fields, but the edge table beside it does.

The sidebar shows '… 68 above' before iHRIS_Person and '… 21 below · all 93' after iHRIS_PersonID_Type. Both are correct: in the 93-record sorted ihris-common list, iHRIS_Person is the 69th and iHRIS_PersonID_Type the 72nd. Each list link now names its class in the edge table and the phone list: country iHRIS_Country, county iHRIS_County, district iHRIS_District, region iHRIS_Region. The field-table 'Draws from' links still show only the form name, which is acceptable because the neighbourhood names the class.

notes.H2: A faithful, tight refinement of H. Six of the eight fixes are done fully, all facts are correct, and web usability is unchanged or better. Two things remain before acceptance, both small. (1) Raise the phone nav touch targets to 44px, including the 'all 93' link (e.g. '.nav a { display:block; min-height:44px; }' in the open state). (2) Fix the menu button's accessible name: drop aria-label so the visible 'Menu' or 'Close' is the name, or make it contain that text. Point aria-controls at a wrapper that also holds the tile. Cosmetic: keep the tile's ◯—◯ glyph on one line (white-space:nowrap).

factualIssues.issue: No factual errors found. The only mismatch is between the intent and the markup, not the data: fix 1's 44px requirement is not met by the 32px nav links in h2-menu.html.

verified: Checked against src/*/data-model/4.3.3/*.json. iHRIS_Person (ihris-common): extends I2CE_Form; form person; definedIn ihris-common/module/Person (src/ihris-common/modules/4.3.3/Person.json exists); six fields in order, with labels, types and required flags (surname_ignore has a null label); nationality references country; residence references country, county, district and region. Subclasses: exactly iHRIS_ManagePerson (field password) and iHRIS_QualifyPerson (field home). No I2CE_Form record exists. The lists country, county, district and region are the forms of iHRIS_Country, iHRIS_County, iHRIS_District and iHRIS_Region, all in ihris-common. Package counts: i2ce 12, ihris-common 93, ihris-manage 26, ihris-qualify 25, for 156 records and 153 distinct classes. The classes defined twice are iHRIS_DisciplinaryAction (qualify, manage), iHRIS_Registration (qualify, common) and iHRIS_SalaryGrade (common, manage). In the sorted ihris-common list (the same under C and locale collation), iHRIS_Person is 69th, so 68 are above it (iHRIS_NextOfKin and iHRIS_Notes are directly before). iHRIS_PersonID_Type is 72nd, so 21 are below it (iHRIS_PersonLanguage is next). formClass.json is gone after ihris-73by and the counts are still 93/156/153. uploads/ihris-suite-4.3.3/manifest.json has md5 398b1808ba0f4528a8c204ad7eea090a with md5MatchesUpstream true. authors.json was not opened.
